description: Explore molecules with Codex and keep changing the same scene on your computer and WebXR headset.

interface.longDescription:
Explore your molecule in depth, with Codex changing the scene as you ask. Reveal a binding pocket. Highlight a ligand. Make the surrounding protein transparent so you can inspect what matters.

Start on your laptop, then open the same scene in a WebXR headset. Rotate and enlarge the molecule, change representations, or switch structures without pairing again. Keep typing or dictating requests while the connected desktop and headset views update.

Build a guided molecular lesson, step through its chapters, and pause to investigate a detail. Continue working in the same saved scene across sessions. Desktop stereo modes also let you explore depth on a regular screen.
